prompt:
Single full-bleed vertical3:5 game upgrade-card painting, final720x1200 RGB. References are this project's original card paintings: match their coarse thick digital oil/impasto brushwork, desaturated dark charcoal/deep brown palette, northern knotwork materials, upper-left key light and heroic slightly low-angle half-length portrait. NOT pixel art, NOT photography, no glossy3D. Face and ALL identifying objects in upper55%; top of head near y8-12%, face around y18-30%, hands above y48%; bottom40% very dark plain drapery/haze with minimal detail, reserved for text overlay. Keep important objects inside x7%-93% and y5%-53%, not cropped. Real anatomically connected hands, coherent weapons and natural face. No text, typography, readable words, border, signature, logo, watermark. Small abstract magical geometric marks allowed, never lines of readable writing. One finished image.
EDIT the reference into its AWAKENED variant. Preserve EXACT same young gentle male face/eyes, platinum-white shoulder hair, faint sad expression, pose and camera framing, light armor/ivory robe, mistletoe twig, left-up key and hand at chest. Release full warm-white-gold #FFF2B3 light: brilliant but textured rays fan out from upper chest and shoulders, tall warm-white light columns pierce the dark background on both sides of head, halo becomes stronger. Face and fingers remain normally exposed, detailed and readable, not erased by bloom. Broad oil paint streaks and luminous impasto, not lens-flare photo. More powerful than normal, brightness concentrated in upper55%; keep lower40% simple deep grey-brown drapery and charcoal haze so text mask still works. No extra wings, weapons, hands, people or symbols; preserve identity and composition.
